final: WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average FROM name_averages) SELECT n.event_name, n.average_amount, n.average_amount - o.mean_average AS amount_above_mean, n.average_amount / o.mean_average AS ratio_to_mean FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.average_amount > o.mean_average
